description: Climb a codebase: a terrain map of the repository and guided reading trails with comprehension checkpoints, including a climb over the uncommitted changes an AI agent just made.
welcome.trail:
Read this repository along a trail of 12–15 segments, from its entry points to its summits.
[$(debug-start) Start a full climb](command:thrubase.climbFull)
[$(git-compare) Start a diff climb](command:thrubase.climbDiff)
Thrubase never runs your code. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you add an LLM key for guides.
config.cliPath: Explicit path to the `thrubase` CLI. Empty: look on PATH, then in the pipx environment, then use `uvx thrubase`.
config.diffSuggestThreshold: Number of changed functions and methods that makes the status bar suggest a diff climb.
config.llm.provider: LLM provider for short segment guides. `none` keeps everything local; checkpoints work either way.
config.llm.model: Model name. Empty: the provider default.
config.llm.endpoint: Endpoint for `openai-compatible` providers, e.g. `http://localhost:11434/v1` for Ollama.
config.language: Language of the Thrubase UI and questions. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
color.segmentBackground: Background of the current trail segment in the editor.
